pages.quiz:
COMPUTER STUDIES OCTOBER — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: COMPUTER STUDIES OCTOBER
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Binary Arithmetic Operations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Binary Arithmetic Operations.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Binary Arithmetic Operations.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Binary Arithmetic Operations.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Binary Arithmetic Operations.

2. When learning Network Security, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Network Security.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Network Security.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Network Security.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Network Security.

3. When learning Relational Database Fundamentals, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Relational Database Fundamentals.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Relational Database Fundamentals.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Relational Database Fundamentals.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Relational Database Fundamentals.

4. When learning Computer Network Standards and Protocols, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Network Standards and Protocols.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Network Standards and Protocols.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Computer Network Standards and Protocols.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Network Standards and Protocols.

5. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

6. When learning Data Representation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Data Representation.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Data Representation.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data Representation.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Data Representation.

7. When learning Structured Query Language, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Structured Query Language.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Structured Query Language.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Structured Query Language.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Structured Query Language.

8. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Speaker
   C. Keyboard
   D. Monitor

9. When learning Logic Circuits, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Logic Circuits.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Logic Circuits.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Logic Circuits.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Logic Circuits.

10. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Remove all guards

11. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Ignore burnt cables

12. When learning Object Oriented Programming Implementation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Object Oriented Programming Implementation.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Object Oriented Programming Implementation.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Object Oriented Programming Implementation.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Object Oriented Programming Implementation.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Structured Query Language and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Web Development Fundamentals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Data Representation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Binary Arithmetic Operations and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

5. B — Information and Communication Technology

8. A — CPU

11. C — Never touch live wires with wet hands

12. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Object Oriented Programming Implementation.
